paraphrase: The marriage of the son of the cobbler-devotee Haraḷayya to the daughter of the brāhmaṇa-devotee Madhuvarasa outrages the orthodox; king Bijjala has both fathers put to death; violence follows, the king is killed and the śaraṇas are scattered.
speaker: Pālkuriki Sōmanātha (narrator)
notes: Skeleton from memory; locator is the incipit (or a descriptive key when the incipit is not recalled) because vacana numbering differs between editions — fix against the Samagra Vacana Sāhitya in Phase D. Accounts of the Kalyāṇa events differ between hagiographies (and a Jaina account is hostile); which details stand in Sōmanātha's text must be checked in Phase D.
